content.title: THE MINERAL YOUR THYROID IS SILENTLY {{BEGGING}} FOR
facts: **Copper** (Collagen Builder) — Cashew Alternative: Sesame Seeds | Lentils | Dark Leafy Greens | Shiitake Mushrooms
**Manganese** (Bone & Joint Support) — Mussels | Pineapple Alternative: Brown Rice | Chickpeas | Pecans
**Selenium** (Thyroid Protector) — Sunflower Seeds | Eggs | Sardines | Whole Wheat Bread
**Chromium** (Blood Sugar Balancer) — Broccoli | Grape Juice | Whole Grain Oats | Green Beans
**Phosphorus** (Energy Converter) — Pumpkin Seeds | Salmon | Lentils | Greek Yogurt
**Molybdenum** (Detox Enzyme Helper) — Black-Eyed Peas | Lentils | Oats | Sunflower Seeds
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Copper doesn't just build collagen for skin, it actually helps your body absorb and use iron properly, so a hidden copper shortage can quietly mimic iron-deficiency fatigue. Selenium works as a building block for enzymes that protect your thyroid gland from oxidative stress, which is why low levels are linked to sluggish thyroid function over time. Chromium plays a role in helping insulin do its job more efficiently, so it can support steadier energy levels between meals instead of the crash-and-craving cycle. That said, everyone's body is different, so pay attention to how you personally feel and adjust from there.
